sample_unit: ChatGPT responses and patient information sheets (three urological malignancies)

links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading ease of ChatGPT patient information versus institutional patient information sheets
links.effect: ChatGPT readability was non-inferior to Cancer Council Australia and UpToDate sheets, and improved further when the prompt targeted a 16-year-old audience. No numeric scores are reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Ease of use of the information generated from ChatGPT was increased further when the question was modified to target an audience of 16 years of age, the average level of education attained by an Australian.

unlisted_practices: Prompting a generative AI model to target a specific age or education level to improve readability of patient education content

screen.reason: Evaluates readability of ChatGPT responses to urological malignancy questions and tests the effect of modifying prompts to specify a target reading age/level.
